subtitle: Leo works through 12 modules on used to for past habits: word lab, warm up, the rule, detective, build it, sort, practice, survey, word web, guess the ending, quiz, and Dribble!

content: Practice used to for past habits independently across 12 interactive modules.
Sort correct used to sentences from broken ones.
